children: Hardware wallet maker Keystone confirmed that a security breach at its website exposed some customers’ addresses and order details. According to ChainCatcher, Keystone said it acted immediately after discovering the vulnerability and blocked unauthorized access. The company has fixed the vulnerability and said payment details, recovery phrases, and private keys were not affected. Keystone said it will continue strengthening its security measures.

title: Keystone Website Attack Exposes Customer Addresses and Order Details
